mapper.select: SELECT center_no as centerNo, center_name as centerName, type FROM fitness_center WHERE member_id = #{partnerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO partner_ad (member_id, payment_type, payment_amount, payment_at, package_name, prev_balance, after_amt) VALUES (#{partnerId}, #{paymentType}, #{paymentAmount}, NOW(), #{packageName}, 0, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE fitness_center SET is_ad = #{isAd} WHERE center_no = #{centerNo}
mapper.select: SELECT c.center_name as centerName, CONCAT(a.ad_type, '|', IFNULL(a.billing_model, 'CPT')) as adType, a.start_date as adStartDate, a.end_date as adEndDate, DATEDIFF(a.end_date, NOW()) as remainingDays, (CASE WHEN a.ad_status = 0 THEN 2 WHEN (a.ad_status = 1 OR a.ad_status IS NULL) AND NOW() BETWEEN a.start_date AND a.end_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as isAd FROM advertisement a JOIN fitness_center c ON a.center_no = c.center_no WHERE a.partner_id = #{partnerId} ORDER BY a.ad_id DESC

SELECT p.partner_payments_id as paymentId, p.payment_type as paymentType, p.package_name as packageName, p.payment_amount as paymentAmount, DATE_FORMAT(p.payment_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as paymentAt, IFNULL(u.user_name, '알수없음') as partnerName, IFNULL(u.login_id, '알수없음') as loginId FROM partner_ad p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.member_id = u.member_id ORDER BY p.payment_at DESC

SELECT a.ad_id as adId, a.center_no as centerNo, c.center_name as centerName, a.ad_title as adTitle, a.ad_content as adContent, a.ad_type as adType, IFNULL(a.target_keyword, '키워드 없음') as targetKeyword, a.bid_price as bidPrice, DATE_FORMAT(a.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as requestDate FROM advertisement a JOIN fitness_center c ON a.center_no = c.center_no WHERE a.ad_status = 0 ORDER BY a.bid_price DESC, a.start_date ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE advertisement SET ad_status = #{status} WHERE ad_id = #{adId}
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(click_date, '%m/%d') as dateLabel, COUNT(*) as clickCount FROM ad_click WHERE ad_id IN (SELECT ad_id FROM advertisement WHERE partner_id = #{partnerId}) AND click_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY dateLabel ORDER BY dateLabel ASC

SELECT IFNULL(a.target_keyword, '기타') as keyword, COUNT(c.click_id) as cnt FROM advertisement a LEFT JOIN ad_click c ON a.ad_id = c.ad_id WHERE a.partner_id = #{partnerId} GROUP BY keyword ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT ad_id as adId, billing_model as billingModel, cost_per_action as costPerAction, remaining_budget as remainingBudget FROM advertisement WHERE center_no = #{centerNo} AND ad_status = 1 AND NOW() BETWEEN start_date AND end_date LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ad_click (ad_id, center_no, click_date) VALUES (#{adId}, #{centerNo}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE advertisement SET remaining_budget = remaining_budget - cost_per_action, ad_status = CASE WHEN remaining_budget - cost_per_action <= 0 THEN 2 ELSE ad_status END WHERE ad_id = #{adId}
